content.text: Please build Taco Cometa’s sample restaurant website to help hungry customers quickly choose what to eat and figure out how to visit. Prioritize a clear, appetizing menu with a few signature tacos and vegetarian options, readable sample prices, and a prominent visit section with clearly labeled fictional/sample location, hours, and contact details. Make it work well on mobile and feel warm, lively, and easy to scan. Keep all operational details explicitly sample content; no checkout, ordering flow, or deployment.

I’ll make a self-contained mobile-friendly page with a scannable sample menu and a prominent visit section. I’ll first check the available brief and browser tools so the copy stays within confirmed details, then I’ll open the saved page in the shared browser.
